question: What is the full form of ATM?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Automated Teller Machine**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Automated teller machines (ATMs) are electronic banking transactions that allow you to complete transactions without entering a bank branch.
 
• Some ATMs are basic cash dispensers
